# EndIf <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Control Flow](Language-Features-Control-Flow)

</div>


```blitzbasic
EndIf
End If
```

## Description

Ends the block form of an [If](If). `EndIf` and `End If` mean the same thing.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
If 1
	Print "block"
End If
```

```text
block
```
